verdict.rationale: Codegen's main output already lives in the user's own GitHub repositories as branches, commits and PRs, and the CLI can pull agent work locally. The API can also list agent runs and retrieve detailed traces and execution logs, so data can be extracted piecemeal. There is no documented bulk export, no stated open export format, and no offboarding or account-deletion path. Missing for 10: a documented full-account export feature, open/standard export formats for agent runs, traces and settings, data-deletion/offboarding documentation, and independent corroboration.
